title: Triboluminescence
description: Some crystals flash light when crushed, scratched or pulled apart: crunch a lump of sugar in the dark and it sparks blue. Coatings that glow where they're strained can show cracks in bridges and wings.
effect: some crystals give off light when crushed or strained
pickWhy: Renamed from the database's umbrella term to the oldest named form; Bacon described sugar sparking in 1605.
edbDesc: Light emission resulting from any mechanical action on a solid. It can be produced through ultrasound, or through other means.
